payout_quote: A global community of 150,000+ verified security researchers helps uncover vulnerabilities before malicious actors can exploit them.
steps: Register a free Intigriti researcher account.
Browse the 400+ active bug bounty programs.
Read each program's scope, rewards, and rules of engagement.
Test in-scope assets ethically and submit vulnerability reports via Intigriti.
Intigriti's triage validates the report; on client acceptance, payment is automatically processed.
catches: Only in-scope, unique, well-written reports that pass triage are paid.
Bounty amounts are set per program; no platform-wide payout range.
Private/invite-only programs are limited to vetted high-ranking researchers.
Requires real security skills; beginners earn nothing for a long time.
Violating rules of engagement can end your access.
biggest_catch: Payment requires validated, in-scope, unique findings — most testing time produces no payout.
eligibility: Free researcher account; security testing skills.
timing: 400+ programs run continuously; payment processed on client acceptance.

c1.evidence: Intigriti's own site states the mechanism: 'Inscope, unique and wellwritten reports are submitted to client... Client accepts report, and payment is automatically processed' with '400+' active programs.

c2.evidence: Official terms tie payment to accepted valid reports per program — amounts are program-set; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: register, browse programs, read scope/rules, test, submit, triage, paid on acceptance.

c4.evidence: Joining and participating are free; no upfront fee documented.

s1.note: Eligibility is a free researcher account.

s2.note: Framed as variable per-program bounties; no fixed amount promised.

s3.note: Catches cover triage-gated payment and skill requirements.

s4.note: Deduped: no Intigriti route in qa/existing-providers.txt, dedupe-check.py, or qa/verification/*.json.
